name: Device status
decode: 0x1 = critical error; maintenance needed; 0x2 = error; device may recover; 0x4 = warning; 0x8 = notification; 0x10 = calibration mode active

name: Error code
interpretation: Signed 32-bit value; low word first at register 514 then high word at 515; interpret status bits as a mask.
decode: 0x1 = T sensor measurement failure; 0x4 = RH sensor measurement failure; 0x8 = reference capacitance failure; 0x10 = ambient temperature too high; 0x40 = device settings corrupted; 0x400 = factory settings corrupted; 0x8000 = calibration expired; 0x10000 = calibration about to expire

name: RH measurement status
decode: 0x2 = reading unreliable; 0x4 = under range; 0x8 = over range; 0x20 = value locked; 0x40 = calibration expired; 0x80 = sensor failure; 0x100 = measurement not ready

name: Temperature status
decode: 0x2 = reading unreliable; 0x4 = under range; 0x8 = over range; 0x20 = value locked; 0x40 = calibration expired; 0x80 = sensor failure; 0x100 = measurement not ready
